value.title: CMS Architecture & WordPress Endpoint Auditing
value.content: {"id": "recon_meth_012", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "recon", "name": "CMS Architecture & WordPress Endpoint Auditing", "prerequisites": ["cms_internals", "rest_api_principles"], "signals": ["wordpress_rest_api", "wp_json_users_endpoint", "author_sitemap_xml", "plugin_debug_log"], "verification_strategy": "Probe common Content Management System (CMS) interfaces for unauthenticated user enumeration routes (/wp-json/wp/v2/users, ?author=1), public debug logs, and outdated plugin components.", "evidence_requirements": ["enumerated_username_list", "debug_log_content_proof"], "remediation_pattern": "Disable public access to the WordPress REST API users endpoint for unauthenticated visitors, disable display of debug logs in production, and keep core/plugins updated.", "description": "Specialized reconnaissance methodology for identifying user enumerations, configuration leaks, and exposed debugging interfaces in popular CMS deployments."}
